{{Top|Leg}}
The '''GX-9 Pretormin vaporator''' was a [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]] manufactured by [[Pretormin Environmental/Legends|Pretormin Environmental]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the six years leading up to the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the farmer [[Orrin Gault]] invested in several fields of Pretormin vaporators which he hoped to use to produce sweet-tasting water. However, Gault was unable to figure out the sweet-water formula and the vaporators produced bitter-tasting water.<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>

As Gault's investment failed, he became indebted to banks and was forced to borrow money from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. To pay off his debts, Gault started a protection racket known as the [[Settlers' Call Fund]] to defend settlers against [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. Gault and [[Gault family|his family]] also staged false flag attacks, which were falsely attributed to the Tuskens. Facing pressure from Jabba's enforcers, Gault attempted to marry business owner [[Annileen Calwell]] in order to acquired her assets to settle his debts. However, Calwell learned of his deception and joined forces with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[A'Yark/Legends|A'Yark]] 's Tusken clan, and Jabba's enforcers to expose Gault's deception and crimes.<ref name="Kenobi" />
